category.description: Enterprise audit finding category. Use direction-disagreement only for taste or strategy disputes that evidence cannot settle.

layer.description: The enterprise gate layer being audited or blocked.

redline.description: True when the finding blocks the layer gate until fixed, falsified with evidence, or human-overridden.

evidence.description: Must be path:line or verbatim command output. Free-text LLM assertion does not qualify.

unsupported.description: Set true when evidence does not meet path:line or command-output standard. Auto-classified low severity.
